task_description: Build a complete CLI Proof-of-Work mining tool for the JAY Network. The tool connects to the mining pool via WebSocket, receives work, computes SHA-256 hashes using multiple worker threads, and submits valid shares. It features colored CLI output with hashrate display, auto-reconnection, and configurable threads/wallet.

verification.summary: npm install completes successfully. CLI --help works. All modules load. Worker threads correctly compute SHA-256 hashes and detect valid shares (verified with difficulty=100 test). Live mining test connects and shows proper reconnection with exponential backoff. Token fetch gets 429/403 from pool (rate limiting from sandbox IP) which is expected - code handles it correctly.
